mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_catalog (product_id, name, definition, key_conditions, required_materials, risk_points, trigger, prohibited_phrases, evidence_source, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{name}, #{definition}, #{keyConditions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{requiredMaterials, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{riskPoints, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{trigger}, #{prohibitedPhrases, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{evidenceSource}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, name, definition, key_conditions, required_materials, risk_points, trigger, prohibited_phrases, evidence_source, created_at FROM product_catalog WHERE product_id = #{productId}
